title: nextjs-server-action-skill Output
description: Output specification for the nextjs-server-action-skill. Validates the produced Server Action file metadata.

file_path.description: Path of the created Server Action file.

zod_schema_name.description: Name of the module-level Zod schema used for input validation.

auth_checked.description: Confirms await auth() is the first call in the function body.

audit_logged.description: Confirms auditLog() is called after the successful DB operation.

ownership_check_present.description: Confirms resource.userId === session.user.id check is present (when required).

lines_of_code.description: Total lines of code in the file.

dal_used.description: Confirms no direct prisma import — DAL used for all DB access.

uses_server_directive.description: Confirms 'use server' is the first line.
